scope: Approved precision-instrument HUD; no smoke/audio/art/physics integration
nativeAdmission: Pending explicit art handback, fresh census and lease ownership

scenarios.stimulus: Fresh compiled isolated stage, same qualified Arland/native player-camera fixture, actual settled healthy gunner, native ADS
scenarios.expect: One visible custom root; all required widgets present; correctly centered accepted reticle; faithful dark lower panel and German top caps; no missing resource/script errors or loading capture
scenarios.boundary: Scripted native boarding/ADS is not physical user input evidence

scenarios.stimulus: Native 2x/4x/6x/8x optic magnification; supported 16:9 and 16:10 plus narrow4:3/wide21:9 visual checks where available
scenarios.expect: Reticle aiming reference stays at native viewport center; magnification reports actual value with German comma; labels/frames/glyphs stay readable and within screen; lower panel leaves useful target view
scenarios.boundary: Offline coordinate bounds cannot prove native legibility or ballistic alignment

scenarios.stimulus: Ordinary gunner input Shift+V cycles BEIDE/LINKS/RECHTS; short safe actual bursts with left then right selected
scenarios.expect: Selection marks match actual group; each numeric count and segmented bar follows its own real magazine count/capacity; full counts produce full bars; no invented AP feed; unavailable state never looks full
evidence: actual weapon group and pre/post ammo snapshots
scenarios.boundary: No magazine setter may substitute for successful actual firing

scenarios.stimulus: C on near ground and a distant valid surface; sky/no-return; leave and re-enter ADS; N toggles actual day/low-light state
scenarios.expect: ENTFERNUNG tracks real provider value/state; invalid/unmeasured range is visibly unavailable, never a stale valid value; no debug/development strings; TAG/RESTLICHT matches actual optics; no ballistic or stabilization-ready claim
scenarios.boundary: Measured range is not a correction/impact pass

scenarios.stimulus: Ordinary traverse left/right with hull stationary; elevate/depress; then change hull orientation safely
scenarios.expect: Recognizable fixed bow-up Gepard hull remains hull reference; turret/gun direction follows native hull-relative yaw; TURM/HÖHE numbers follow actual angles; no fictitious world-heading or vehicle damage visualization
scenarios.boundary: Presentation inspection does not establish stabilization or a new damage model

scenarios.stimulus: Exit ADS to cabin, reopen ADS, open/close menu, leave/re-enter gunner seat; optional controlled death/control-loss only in a separate fresh QA run
scenarios.expect: No orphan panel/reticle outside eligible local gunner ADS; full UI recovers once; stock HUD returns appropriately; range scope clears; no duplicate widgets/listeners or restlight leakage
scenarios.boundary: Keep the user's live demo untimed and free of delayed automation

manualSession: Judge the overall concept match and lower-panel height at2x, then cycle your normal zoom steps.
Shift+V through cannon groups; fire a short safe burst from each side and watch its number/bar.
C on near ground, distant ground and sky; N to RESTLICHT and back.
Traverse/elevate: the bow-up Gepard diagram and TURM/HÖHE must agree with relative gun direction.
Leave/reopen optic and seat once: the panel should disappear and recover cleanly.
acceptance: Only user in-game judgment plus scenario evidence can accept the new HUD. Whole GEP005/006/008 remain unchecked where acceptance is missing.
release: No publication before user in-game approval; accepted driving and stock sounds stay unchanged
